title: The cutover summary asserts `-PhlimboV2` phUSD minter movement unconditionally, contradicting the same run's Phase 0 read of `V2 holds phUSD mint: false` and the verifier's own conditional NOTE
originBasis: Split from PR24-01 per FR-24-01. PR24-01's own originBasis (independent carryover re-check against all 111 ledger entries, 0 exact matches; semantic sweep of all 18 promotion-ready:* entries) covered the bundled record including this instance; no ledger entry names _printSummary or the summary-delta claim. NEW.
description: `_printSummary` prints `phUSD minter-set DELTA (story 076): +PhlimboV3, -PhlimboV2. Nothing else moved.` (:3114) unconditionally on every run, including a broadcast, while the same run's Phase 0 output reads `V2 holds phUSD mint: false` with membership mask 270080 - so the `-PhlimboV2` half is a no-op the summary asserts happened. `VerifyPromotionReady._verifyMintAuthorityInvariance` handles the identical case correctly and conditionally at :259-263, printing `NOTE: PhlimboV2 did not hold phUSD mint authority at Phase 0 - the revoke was a no-op.` when the baseline bit is clear and the affirmative line only when it was set. The deploy log and the verify log of the same cutover therefore disagree about whether an authority movement occurred.
impact: No state divergence: PhlimboV2 could not mint phUSD before the run and cannot after it, so the end state matches the claim's intent even though the claimed transition never happened. The impact is confined to the deploy record - a reader certifying the cutover from the deploy log alone concludes a revoke occurred that did not, and must reconcile it against a verify log that says the opposite.
evidence: Observed in this run's own dry run and reproduced against the source: script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:3114 (unconditional console.log inside _printSummary, :3093-3120) vs script/VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:259-263 (the conditional NOTE/affirmative branch on `phusdMinterMaskAtPhase0 & v2Bit == 0`). Phase 0 output for the same run: `V2 holds phUSD mint: false`, `membership mask: 270080`. Live corroboration at block 25678182: phUSD.authorizedMinters(PhlimboV2) reads (false, 0). ORIGINAL BUNDLED TEXT, preserved verbatim from PR24-01.evidence: "SECOND INSTANCE OF THE SAME CLASS, found in my own dry run and not previously recorded: the cutover summary block prints `phUSD minter-set DELTA (story 076): +PhlimboV3, -PhlimboV2. Nothing else moved.` unconditionally on every run, including a broadcast, even though the same run's own Phase 0 output five screens earlier reads `V2 holds phUSD mint: false` and `membership mask: 270080` - i.e. the `-PhlimboV2` half is a no-op. The VERIFIER handles this correctly with a conditional NOTE (VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:259-263); the deploy script's summary does not."
recommendation: Make the summary's `-PhlimboV2` clause conditional on `phusdMinterMaskAtPhase0 & (1 << PHUSD_MINTER_BIT_PHLIMBO_V2) != 0`, mirroring the NOTE the verifier already prints at VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:259-263, so the deploy log and the verify log stop disagreeing about whether a revoke happened. When the bit was clear at Phase 0, print `+PhlimboV3 only; PhlimboV2 held no phUSD mint authority at Phase 0, so the revoke was a no-op. Nothing else moved.` The conditional already exists in the suite and can be copied. (Preserved verbatim from PR24-01.recommendation: "Separately, make the summary's `-PhlimboV2` line conditional on `phusdMinterMaskAtPhase0 & (1 << PHUSD_MINTER_BIT_PHLIMBO_V2) != 0`, mirroring the NOTE the verifier already prints at VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:259-263, so the deploy log and the verify log stop disagreeing about whether a revoke happened.")

relatedFindings.relationship: PARENT - split from it per FR-24-01. Shares the theme 'the log claims what the code does not establish', but a different artifact, property, remediation and severity.

relatedFindings.relationship: ancestor control - the post-broadcast verification story 075 built; Q-01 is a disagreement BETWEEN the deploy record and that control, not a gap in it.

classification.assetImpact: None. End state is unaffected: V2 does not hold the phUSD mint grant at Phase 0 and does not hold it afterwards. Only the deploy record is wrong.
attackPath: 1. _printSummary (:3114) prints 'phUSD minter-set DELTA (story 076): +PhlimboV3, -PhlimboV2. Nothing else moved.' UNCONDITIONALLY on every run, including a broadcast.
2. The same run's own Phase 0 output, five screens earlier, reads 'V2 holds phUSD mint: false' with membership mask 270080 - so the -PhlimboV2 half is a no-op the summary asserts happened.

3. VerifyPromotionReady._verifyMintAuthorityInvariance handles the identical case correctly and conditionally (VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:259-263: 'NOTE: PhlimboV2 did not hold phUSD mint authority at Phase 0 - the revoke was a no-op.' vs the affirmative branch).

4. Consequence: the deploy log and the verify log of the same cutover contradict each other about whether a revoke occurred, and a reader certifying the cutover from the deploy record alone concludes an authority movement happened that did not.
classification.likelihood: Certain on current state - the mask bit is clear today, so every run prints the false half.
classification.whyNotLow: Unlike L-05, no assertion or control is claimed-but-absent here: the property the summary misreports is independently and correctly verified by VerifyPromotionReady:259-263 on the same cutover. The defect is confined to one console.log's phrasing, with no path by which a wrong belief survives the verify step.
classification.splitBasis: SPLIT FROM PR24-01 (FR-24-01), exercising the authority dedup and sanitizer explicitly declined. Grounds: (1) different artifact - _printSummary's deploy-log output at :3114 vs _phase7_phlimboV3Assertions' missing require at :2418-2454; (2) different property - the phUSD minter-set delta vs PhlimboV2's pause state; (3) different remediation with zero overlap - gate the -PhlimboV2 line on phusdMinterMaskAtPhase0 & (1 << PHUSD_MINTER_BIT_PHLIMBO_V2) != 0, vs add require(!v2.paused()) to Phase 7; fixing either leaves the other fully live; (4) different severity - the summary line is contradicted and corrected by a verifier check that already exists, while L-05's property is proven nowhere at all. Bundling them would have forced one severity onto two defects and hidden a QA-grade log fix inside a Low-grade coverage gap. Both are labelled and both travel to the report.

justification: QA. C4 QA/Low explicitly covers 'issues with comments' and incorrect reporting. No state diverges, no control fails open, no value is at risk - V2 could not mint before the run and cannot after it. The reason it is filed rather than dropped is that two logs of the same mainnet cutover disagree, and the verifier already contains the exact conditional the deploy script lacks, making the fix a copy of code already in the suite.
